summary: Polytron's Fez is a perspective-shifting indie puzzle platformer, first released on Xbox Live Arcade and later ported widely to PC, PlayStation, iOS, and Switch.

entries.title: Fez
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC release with controller/rumble and patch state documented

emulation.notes: Native PC route is preferred; use original Xbox hardware only for launch-history comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with display/controller state documented

primary.why: The PC release is current, capture-friendly, and supports the final patched desktop route. The Xbox 360 version is the original timed-exclusive route, while Switch/iOS/PlayStation versions are useful access routes with platform-specific controls and save behavior.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release with a controller if documenting rumble-related puzzles. Record storefront/build, controller/rumble state, language, save slot, completion percentage/cube count, ending route, display scaling, and whether Xbox 360 original or Switch portable play was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original XBLA launch context and patch history
secondary.why: PC is easier to capture and preserve, but Xbox 360 is the origin platform.

secondary.what_to_play: Use for access or platform comparison.
secondary.why: PC remains the main archive route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record rumble/controller availability because some puzzles can depend on controller feedback.
